info.title: API-DocTest-List Hotel Loyalty Points Partners-v1-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Partners API enables users to list and retrieve various partners involved in hotel loyalty programs. This API serves as a valuable resource for applications that aim to provide information on loyalty points partnerships, helping users identify and choose partners aligned with their travel needs. Typical consumers include travel agencies, app developers, and customer loyalty program managers looking to enhance user engagement. Through this API, stakeholders can access detailed data on the partners, fostering more informed decisions and optimized loyalty rewards.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of partners associated with points.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the partners related to the points system. It provides a comprehensive overview of all the partners currently integrated, facilitating the management and analysis of point-related partnerships.
